newsitem.title: USA: Clinton, Hashimoto likely to meet April 25.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Hashimoto likely to meet April 25.

text.p: President Bill Clinton and Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto are likely to meet in Washington April 25, U.S. officials said on Thursday.
The officials, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said an announcement of the meeting will be forthcoming.

White House spokesman Mike McCurry, while not confirming the meeting date, said relations with Japan were warm and cordial and that, "I'm sure, hypothetically, if we got together with the prime minister of Japan towards the end of the month, we would have exactly that kind of meeting."
He said they would review the "full range and full aspects of our bilateral relationships."
"Increasingly, when we meet with the prime minister of Japan, we no longer focus on those difficult trade issues that so dominated the relationship in the past," he said.
